# DeluxFit by Angie

> Fitness memberships, personalized online coaching, and live one-on-one
> training delivered by Angie, a certified personal trainer. Every program is
> run by her directly: no templates, no resold plans. The site is available in
> English and Spanish.

Four programs are sold, and they are separate products rather than tiers of one
thing. Prices below are exact.

## Programs

- [Delux Fit Membership](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/membership): $14.99 a
  month. General, non-personalized fitness content: workout programs, an
  exercise library, training videos, fitness education, and a general nutrition
  guide. No coaching is included.
- [Personalized Online Coaching](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/online-coaching):
  $150 a month. A workout plan and training schedule built around the client's
  goals, monthly progress reviews and check-ins, basic nutrition guidance, and
  direct messaging to Angie inside the platform. Response time is up to 72
  business hours. There is no live session and no phone access.
- [Single Live Training Session](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/single-session):
  $75 for one 45 to 60 minute private live session over video. A one-off, meant
  for trying the coaching, learning technique, and form correction.
- [Live Online Personal Training](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/training): $50
  a session, ongoing over Zoom, with Angie present for the whole session. A
  minimum of three sessions a week is recommended.

In-person training is not offered yet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/): the four programs side by side.
- [About Angie](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/about): her background,
  certifications, and coaching approach.
- [Client Stories](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/testimonials): reviews and
  transformation photos, published as clients finish their programs.
- [Contact](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/contact): the message form. Active
  coaching clients use the platform instead.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/privacy): what the site
  collects, what it is used for, who else holds it, and how to have it deleted.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.deluxfitbyangie.com/terms): billing,
  cancellation, rescheduling, refunds, and the health disclaimer.

## Notes

- Coaching communication happens only inside the Delux Fit platform.
- Results vary. The site provides fitness coaching for educational purposes and
  is not a substitute for medical advice.
